unit: mg per mm3 of caliper volume
definition: an excised tumour's mass over its last caliper volume (V = L W^2 / 2 mostly), tumours of 200 mm3 or more; per line the median over papers of each paper's median

spread_log.note: sd of log(mass / volume): between papers (paper medians), between groups of one experiment and between animals of one group (net of the caliper error); the within-group size slope 0.69 varies between papers and is not used
